episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: George attempts to build his dream - a zoo without bars.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: George attempts to rescue two Himalayan black bears from a cave in Matlock.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: The family confront a barrage of hostility from the residents of Upton.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The Mottersheads must hastily organise a benefit to raise money after a bear escape.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: George ventures to London for one last attempt to get planning permission.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: The Mottersheads prepare for the appeal that will decide the fate of the zoo.
